name: native-browser-bridge
description: Route native browser control to an explicitly requested Microsoft Edge or Brave instance.

interface.shortDescription: Native browser control for Edge or Brave
interface.longDescription: Routes Codex browser work to an explicitly requested Microsoft Edge or Brave instance through the first-party ChatGPT extension and the bundled Chrome plugin runtime. It preserves the named browser instead of silently substituting Chrome, Computer Use, or macOS Accessibility. Requires chrome@openai-bundled to remain installed and enabled.
defaultPrompt: Use Native Browser Bridge to control Brave without Computer Use.
Use Native Browser Bridge to control Microsoft Edge natively.
